package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// A method call resolves by the receiver's TYPE: a local type's method runs
// the original body even when the value is held natively; a method of a
// dependency-owned value reached through a computed receiver runs there.

type Listener chan int

func (l Listener) Addr() error { return errors.New("listener-addr") }
func (l Listener) Accept() int { return <-l }

type Iterator interface{ Iterate() string }

type IteratorFunc func(int) bool

func (f IteratorFunc) Iterate() string {
	if f == nil {
		return "nil iterator"
	}
	return fmt.Sprint("iterator ", f(1))
}

func fromIterator(it Iterator) string { return it.Iterate() }

func addr() error { return errors.New("plain-addr") }

func builder() *strings.Builder {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("built")
	return &b
}

func main() {
	var l Listener = make(chan int, 1)
	l <- 7
	fmt.Println(l.Addr().Error(), l.Accept())

	fmt.Println(fromIterator(IteratorFunc(nil)))
	var f IteratorFunc
	fmt.Println(fromIterator(f))
	positive := func(n int) bool { return n > 0 }
	fmt.Println(fromIterator(IteratorFunc(positive)))

	// Positive control: the named native receiver, and the same value through
	// a variable.
	e := addr()
	fmt.Println(e.Error(), addr().Error(), builder().String(), builder().Len())
	fmt.Println(errors.New("wrapped").Error())
	os.Exit(3)
}
